text:
morgan: follow-up to today's RFC convo. We need a concrete default for tenant egress: lightweight passthrough relays (ephemeral shim) vs per-tenant source-affinity paths that preserve src IP. Capturing tradeoffs and an implementation path.

irene: short summary?

morgan: shim = L4 passthrough relays that SNAT into a shared egress pool. low baseline cost, autoscale-friendly, but loses customer src IP. affinity = provisioned per-tenant egress (ENI/NAT or dedicated IPs) so partner firewalls see original srcIP; higher infra/quota costs.

sam: ops: shim is simple to operate (stateless relays behind LB). affinity means provisioning plumbing + ENI/NAT quotas to watch. Shim causes issues for customers that do IP allowlisting.

alex: security: headers (X-Redwood-Tenant) help app tracing but won't satisfy downstream firewalls. Also TLS handling matters: prefer L4 passthrough to avoid breaking SNI-based routing.

kat: quick cost snapshot for 500 tenants we modeled: shim ~$6k/mo, affinity (ENI per tenant) ~$23k/mo. Shim adds small latency (median +8ms, p95 +25-35ms) which we can reduce via regional relays + conn pooling.

jay: compliance customers will ask for preserve-srcip. Can we ship shim as default and offer a paid preserve-srcip addon?

morgan: proposal: default=ephemeral shim (L4 passthrough) for hosted tenants; enterprise addon=preserve-srcip with two options: (A) ENI-per-tenant (strong isolation) or (B) pooled mapped IPs (cheaper, needs mapping automation).

irene: agree but provisioning automation + quota checks must be in place. Also decide fallback behavior: if affinity path fails, default should be fail-closed for preserve-srcip unless customer opts into fail-open.

sam: runbook essentials: regional autoscale, healthchecks, circuit-breaker/fallback, metrics: per-tenant egress_bytes, snat_assigned_count, conn_reuse_ratio, and trace header propagation.

alex: implementation note: keep shim passthrough using tproxy+haproxy to allow upstream socket reuse without terminating TLS. We'll document the iptables/tproxy snippet in runtime docs.

kat: product will draft addon pricing and margin bands; legal to review IP-assignment SLAs.

morgan: next actions: write RFC addendum (owner=morgan), eng spike for shim perf (sam+alex), ops provisioning playbook for addon (irene), pricing draft (kat). If no objections I'll land addendum tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex: +1

jay: +1
